title: Omni Crystal Grid
text: Place an Arcane Crystal Grid in the middle node of the Advanced Assembly Table, with an Omni Microcore on each side. Add 3 Genesis Particles and 3 Grid Frames in any order on the tabletop. The upgrade preserves the spell chain and appends empty slots.
Holds 12 spell crystals. Provides a 4x engine output multiplier and an additional 10% spell cooldown reduction when equipped.
